summary.headline: Classe VI, Codex 4
summary.text: Catalogue entry for Classe VI, codex 4, a seventeenth-century Venetian paper manuscript of 33 folios. It records an Italian epistle, a 1585 letter by Maximos Margounios to Iakovos Kontarenos, and a work attributed to Claudius Ptolemy with Achmet son of Joseph as commentator, concerning prognostication and the planets Saturn, Venus, and Mercury.
